The difference cannot be reconciled from here; it strengthens the exclusion rather than loosening it. (2) L-007 FORECAST - THE CONDITIONAL BRANCH FIRED, AND IT TIGHTENED. The 00:00 note forecast N(1h) collapsing toward ~0.15-0.19% on a quiet hour, UNLESS a new impulse bar printed, in which case that bar would bind. A new impulse bar printed: ETHUSDT 16:15Z, 1.074% range = 6.61x the 5m median, the LARGEST 5m bar in the 100-bar window, and it made the 2694.84 breakout high. BINDING N IS THEREFORE 1.074%, STATED BEFORE THE ROLLED-FORWARD VALUE, superseding the 0.878% 14:25Z bar the note said would still bind; required span 2.825%, UP from 2.335%. N(1h) = 0.342% on a fresh 18:00Z bar, so the quiet-collapse branch did not fire either. Fifth consecutive correct forecast. (3) L-004 SPAN SCREEN FAILS, AND THE TWO CONDITIONS ARE DISJOINT AGAIN. ETHUSDT ran to 2697.65 at 16:40Z - 0.41 under the unchanged 24h high 2698.06 - and failed, then made lower highs 2697.65 > 2691.95 > 2687.33 > 2685.71 > 2677.39 > 2671.80 > 2669.61 into an 18:00Z close of 2660.50. Anything below 2633.31 is the vacuum L-004 forbids. The only stop that fits the span - above the most recent lower high 2669.61 - is 0.32% from the entry = 0.30x N, sub-noise, refused by L-002. Noise-safe and span-passing do not overlap anywhere in the set. ZERO constructions were priced. It asked whether a re-passing gate would be the same category set that had flipped twice in two hours. XRPUSDT's bid printed 23.54 USDT at sweep 1 - the smallest XRP bid of the experiment and a SEVENTH consecutive check with an XRP bid collapse - and 2,126 USDT at sweep 3. BTCUSDT's ask printed 823 USDT at sweep 3 and 31,542 at sweep 2 against 21.4M on its bid. ETHUSDT's bid printed 2,664.29 USDT at sweep 2, holding one maximum order by 1.07x. Recorded against interest: sweeps 4 AND 5 were both fully healthy on all five contracts, the first consecutive healthy pair of the experiment, arriving immediately after the worst three sweeps of the check - the oscillation is the finding. The 25 bps cap fired ZERO times, widest spread 12.592 bps (BNB at sweep 5, on the same contract whose bid was worth 53.98 USDT two sweeps earlier) - a SEVENTEENTH consecutive check with the cap blind to the finding (P-009).
